title: Billing Office Calculation Sheet: Amount Collected for an Overdue Delivery Pass Cycle (Delivery & Pickup Services)
content:
An overdue cycle of a Delivery & Pickup Services plan is settled by collecting the plan's subscription fee for that cycle, rounded to the cent.

## Inputs

- **The overdue cycle.** The cycle that began on the plan's current cycle start date, as the plan record shows it.
- **The subscription fee.** The plan's subscription fee per billing cycle, as the Delivery & Pickup Services fee schedule gives it for the plan held.

## The amount

The amount collected is that subscription fee, never below zero, stated to the cent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical overdue cycles)

| Plan held | Subscription fee per cycle | Amount collected for the overdue cycle |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly | $5.99 | $5.99 |
| Kestrel Senior Delivery Pass | $3.99 | $3.99 |
| Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual | $48.00 | $48.00 |

A Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly plan whose charge for the cycle starting 1 May failed is settled for that cycle, the one starting 1 May, at $5.99.
